panels.title: Бета к IMOEX

targets.queryText: WITH b AS (SELECT ts, ret, mret FROM daily WHERE secid = '${ticker}' AND ret IS NOT NULL AND mret IS NOT NULL), r AS (SELECT ts, COUNT(*) OVER w AS n, AVG(ret) OVER w AS ar, AVG(mret) OVER w AS am, AVG(ret * mret) OVER w AS arm, AVG(mret * mret) OVER w AS amm FROM b WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN ${win} - 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) SELECT (arm - ar * am) / (amm - am * am) AS beta FROM r WHERE n = ${win} AND ts <= ${__to:date:seconds} ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
targets.rawQueryText: WITH b AS (SELECT ts, ret, mret FROM daily WHERE secid = '${ticker}' AND ret IS NOT NULL AND mret IS NOT NULL), r AS (SELECT ts, COUNT(*) OVER w AS n, AVG(ret) OVER w AS ar, AVG(mret) OVER w AS am, AVG(ret * mret) OVER w AS arm, AVG(mret * mret) OVER w AS amm FROM b WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN ${win} - 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) SELECT (arm - ar * am) / (amm - am * am) AS beta FROM r WHERE n = ${win} AND ts <= ${__to:date:seconds} ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: R² регрессии на IMOEX

targets.queryText: WITH b AS (SELECT ts, ret, mret FROM daily WHERE secid = '${ticker}' AND ret IS NOT NULL AND mret IS NOT NULL), r AS (SELECT ts, COUNT(*) OVER w AS n, AVG(ret) OVER w AS ar, AVG(mret) OVER w AS am, AVG(ret * mret) OVER w AS arm, AVG(mret * mret) OVER w AS amm, AVG(ret * ret) OVER w AS arr FROM b WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN ${win} - 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) SELECT (arm - ar * am) * (arm - ar * am) / ((amm - am * am) * (arr - ar * ar)) AS r2 FROM r WHERE n = ${win} AND ts <= ${__to:date:seconds} ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Цена ${ticker} и IMOEX, начало периода = 100

targets.queryText: WITH t AS (SELECT d.ts, d.close AS c, i.close AS m FROM daily d JOIN imoex i ON i.ts = d.ts WHERE d.secid = '${ticker}' AND d.ts BETWEEN ${__from:date:seconds} AND ${__to:date:seconds}) SELECT ts AS time, c * 100.0 / FIRST_VALUE(c) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS price, m * 100.0 / FIRST_VALUE(m) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS imoex FROM t ORDER BY ts
targets.rawQueryText: WITH t AS (SELECT d.ts, d.close AS c, i.close AS m FROM daily d JOIN imoex i ON i.ts = d.ts WHERE d.secid = '${ticker}' AND d.ts BETWEEN ${__from:date:seconds} AND ${__to:date:seconds}) SELECT ts AS time, c * 100.0 / FIRST_VALUE(c) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS price, m * 100.0 / FIRST_VALUE(m) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS imoex FROM t ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Регрессия дневной доходности ${ticker} на IMOEX, %: наклон линии равен бете

targets.queryText: SELECT mret * 100 AS imoex, ret * 100 AS ticker FROM daily WHERE secid = '${ticker}' AND ret IS NOT NULL AND mret IS NOT NULL AND ts BETWEEN ${__from:date:seconds} AND ${__to:date:seconds} ORDER BY ts
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT mret * 100 AS imoex, ret * 100 AS ticker FROM daily WHERE secid = '${ticker}' AND ret IS NOT NULL AND mret IS NOT NULL AND ts BETWEEN ${__from:date:seconds} AND ${__to:date:seconds} ORDER BY ts

targets.queryText: WITH b AS (SELECT ret, mret FROM daily WHERE secid = '${ticker}' AND ret IS NOT NULL AND mret IS NOT NULL AND ts BETWEEN ${__from:date:seconds} AND ${__to:date:seconds}), s AS (SELECT AVG(ret) AS ar, AVG(mret) AS am, AVG(ret * mret) AS arm, AVG(mret * mret) AS amm, MIN(mret) AS lo, MAX(mret) AS hi FROM b) SELECT lo * 100 AS imoex, (ar + (arm - ar * am) / (amm - am * am) * (lo - am)) * 100 AS fit FROM s UNION ALL SELECT hi * 100, (ar + (arm - ar * am) / (amm - am * am) * (hi - am)) * 100 FROM s
targets.rawQueryText: WITH b AS (SELECT ret, mret FROM daily WHERE secid = '${ticker}' AND ret IS NOT NULL AND mret IS NOT NULL AND ts BETWEEN ${__from:date:seconds} AND ${__to:date:seconds}), s AS (SELECT AVG(ret) AS ar, AVG(mret) AS am, AVG(ret * mret) AS arm, AVG(mret * mret) AS amm, MIN(mret) AS lo, MAX(mret) AS hi FROM b) SELECT lo * 100 AS imoex, (ar + (arm - ar * am) / (amm - am * am) * (lo - am)) * 100 AS fit FROM s UNION ALL SELECT hi * 100, (ar + (arm - ar * am) / (amm - am * am) * (hi - am)) * 100 FROM s

panels.title: A2 по рынку: среднее по 50 самым торгуемым бумагам дня

targets.queryText: WITH t AS (SELECT ts, a2, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ts ORDER BY val DESC) AS rk FROM daily WHERE a2 IS NOT NULL), m AS (SELECT ts, AVG(a2) AS a2_top50 FROM t WHERE rk <= 50 GROUP BY ts) SELECT ts AS time, a2_top50, AVG(a2_top50) OVER (ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS a2_top50_ma20 FROM m WHERE ts BETWEEN ${__from:date:seconds} AND ${__to:date:seconds} ORDER BY ts
targets.rawQueryText: WITH t AS (SELECT ts, a2, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ts ORDER BY val DESC) AS rk FROM daily WHERE a2 IS NOT NULL), m AS (SELECT ts, AVG(a2) AS a2_top50 FROM t WHERE rk <= 50 GROUP BY ts) SELECT ts AS time, a2_top50, AVG(a2_top50) OVER (ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS a2_top50_ma20 FROM m WHERE ts BETWEEN ${__from:date:seconds} AND ${__to:date:seconds} ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Бета и альфа по 50 самым торгуемым бумагам за последние ${win} торговых дней периода

targets.queryText: WITH r AS (SELECT secid, ret, mret, val, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY secid ORDER BY ts DESC) AS rn FROM daily WHERE ret IS NOT NULL AND mret IS NOT NULL AND ts <= ${__to:date:seconds}), s AS (SELECT secid, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(ret) AS ar, AVG(mret) AS am, AVG(ret * mret) AS arm, AVG(mret * mret) AS amm, AVG(ret * ret) AS arr, SUM(val) AS v FROM r WHERE rn <= ${win} GROUP BY secid HAVING n = ${win} ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 50) SELECT secid AS ticker, (arm - ar * am) / (amm - am * am) AS beta, (ar - (arm - ar * am) / (amm - am * am) * am) * 25200 AS alpha_pct_year, (arm - ar * am) * (arm - ar * am) / ((amm - am * am) * (arr - ar * ar)) AS r2, v / 1000000000.0 AS turnover_bn FROM s ORDER BY v DESC
targets.rawQueryText: WITH r AS (SELECT secid, ret, mret, val, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY secid ORDER BY ts DESC) AS rn FROM daily WHERE ret IS NOT NULL AND mret IS NOT NULL AND ts <= ${__to:date:seconds}), s AS (SELECT secid, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(ret) AS ar, AVG(mret) AS am, AVG(ret * mret) AS arm, AVG(mret * mret) AS amm, AVG(ret * ret) AS arr, SUM(val) AS v FROM r WHERE rn <= ${win} GROUP BY secid HAVING n = ${win} ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 50) SELECT secid AS ticker, (arm - ar * am) / (amm - am * am) AS beta, (ar - (arm - ar * am) / (amm - am * am) * am) * 25200 AS alpha_pct_year, (arm - ar * am) * (arm - ar * am) / ((amm - am * am) * (arr - ar * ar)) AS r2, v / 1000000000.0 AS turnover_bn FROM s ORDER BY v DESC

panels.title: A2, форвард с 2026-10-21: накопленно, п.п. до издержек

targets.queryText: WITH b AS (SELECT ts, secid, a2, LEAD(ret) OVER (PARTITION BY secid ORDER BY ts) AS nret, AVG(val) OVER (PARTITION BY secid ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN 60 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS av FROM daily), u AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ts ORDER BY av DESC) AS rk FROM b WHERE ts >= 1735862400 AND ABS(nret) < 0.5 AND a2 IS NOT NULL AND av IS NOT NULL), u2 AS (SELECT ts, nret, NTILE(5) OVER (PARTITION BY ts ORDER BY a2 DESC) AS q FROM u WHERE rk <= 100), d AS (SELECT ts, AVG(CASE WHEN q = 1 THEN nret END) - AVG(nret) AS spread FROM u2 GROUP BY ts), c AS (SELECT ts AS time, SUM(spread) OVER (ORDER BY ts) * 100 AS all_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN ts >= 1792540800 THEN spread END) OVER (ORDER BY ts) * 100 AS forward_pct FROM d) SELECT forward_pct FROM c WHERE forward_pct IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1
targets.rawQueryText: WITH b AS (SELECT ts, secid, a2, LEAD(ret) OVER (PARTITION BY secid ORDER BY ts) AS nret, AVG(val) OVER (PARTITION BY secid ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN 60 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS av FROM daily), u AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ts ORDER BY av DESC) AS rk FROM b WHERE ts >= 1735862400 AND ABS(nret) < 0.5 AND a2 IS NOT NULL AND av IS NOT NULL), u2 AS (SELECT ts, nret, NTILE(5) OVER (PARTITION BY ts ORDER BY a2 DESC) AS q FROM u WHERE rk <= 100), d AS (SELECT ts, AVG(CASE WHEN q = 1 THEN nret END) - AVG(nret) AS spread FROM u2 GROUP BY ts), c AS (SELECT ts AS time, SUM(spread) OVER (ORDER BY ts) * 100 AS all_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN ts >= 1792540800 THEN spread END) OVER (ORDER BY ts) * 100 AS forward_pct FROM d) SELECT forward_pct FROM c WHERE forward_pct IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Ridge: верхняя треть минус все доступные бумаги, накопленно с 2025-03, п.п.

targets.queryText: WITH b AS (SELECT ts, secid, LEAD(ret) OVER (PARTITION BY secid ORDER BY ts) AS nret FROM daily), j AS (SELECT r.ts, r.p, b.nret FROM ridge r JOIN b ON b.ts = r.ts AND b.secid = r.secid WHERE r.ts >= 1735862400 AND ABS(b.nret) < 0.5), j2 AS (SELECT ts, nret, NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY ts ORDER BY p DESC) AS q FROM j), d AS (SELECT ts, AVG(CASE WHEN q = 1 THEN nret END) - AVG(nret) AS spread FROM j2 GROUP BY ts), c AS (SELECT ts AS time, SUM(spread) OVER (ORDER BY ts) * 100 AS cum_pct FROM d) SELECT cum_pct FROM c ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1
targets.rawQueryText: WITH b AS (SELECT ts, secid, LEAD(ret) OVER (PARTITION BY secid ORDER BY ts) AS nret FROM daily), j AS (SELECT r.ts, r.p, b.nret FROM ridge r JOIN b ON b.ts = r.ts AND b.secid = r.secid WHERE r.ts >= 1735862400 AND ABS(b.nret) < 0.5), j2 AS (SELECT ts, nret, NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY ts ORDER BY p DESC) AS q FROM j), d AS (SELECT ts, AVG(CASE WHEN q = 1 THEN nret END) - AVG(nret) AS spread FROM j2 GROUP BY ts), c AS (SELECT ts AS time, SUM(spread) OVER (ORDER BY ts) * 100 AS cum_pct FROM d) SELECT cum_pct FROM c ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.description: Описательно, без издержек. Зарегистрированный нетто-результат правила A2 (0.15% за сторону) +0.049% в день, docs/metrics.md 8.15; форвардная оценка после 60 дат с 2026-10-21. Из вселенной исключены бумаги с дневной доходностью больше 50% по модулю (сплиты и консолидации).

panels.description: Описательно, без издержек. p меняется раз в 21 день, спред пересчитывается ежедневно; доходность без поправки на дивиденды, модель училась на скорректированной. Состав 14–17 бумаг меняется (YDEX с 2025-08-12, T с 2025-12-09).

targets.queryText: SELECT ts AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN secid = '${ticker}' THEN p END) AS p_ticker, AVG(p) AS p_mean FROM ridge WHERE ts BETWEEN ${__from:date:seconds} AND ${__to:date:seconds} GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ts AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN secid = '${ticker}' THEN p END) AS p_ticker, AVG(p) AS p_mean FROM ridge WHERE ts BETWEEN ${__from:date:seconds} AND ${__to:date:seconds} GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Ridge: последний рейтинг и A2 на ту же дату

targets.queryText: WITH l AS (SELECT MAX(ts) AS t FROM ridge WHERE ts <= ${__to:date:seconds}) SELECT r.secid AS ticker, r.p AS ridge_p, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.p DESC) AS ridge_rank, d.a2_close, d.a2, d.spread_bbo FROM ridge r JOIN l ON r.ts = l.t LEFT JOIN daily d ON d.secid = r.secid AND d.ts = l.t ORDER BY r.p DESC
targets.rawQueryText: WITH l AS (SELECT MAX(ts) AS t FROM ridge WHERE ts <= ${__to:date:seconds}) SELECT r.secid AS ticker, r.p AS ridge_p, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.p DESC) AS ridge_rank, d.a2_close, d.a2, d.spread_bbo FROM ridge r JOIN l ON r.ts = l.t LEFT JOIN daily d ON d.secid = r.secid AND d.ts = l.t ORDER BY r.p DESC
